## Key Projects
- **VoxReach** (https://mistry-harsh.vercel.app/projects/voxreach): AI-powered human-like voice calling agent and hyperlocal analytics platform using RAG+LLM, Cartesia, Sarvam, Twilio, TiDB, FastAPI, and AWS. Automated 85% of customer voice interactions.
- **B2B Scraping & Analytics Tool** (https://mistry-harsh.vercel.app/projects/b2b-scrapping-and-analytics-tool): Multi-threaded concurrent scraping engine with LLM classification (Groq/Gemini), Pandas transformations, and Next.js dashboard.
- **SyncHive** (https://mistry-harsh.vercel.app/projects/synchive): Open-source Python package (v0.2.0 on PyPI) for automated file backup and SSH/FTP sync using Watchdog and Paramiko.
- **TradeIQ** (https://mistry-harsh.vercel.app/projects/tradeiq): AI-powered paper trading & market intelligence platform with seasonal pattern detection, NLP stock query interface, and real-time dashboard.
